summary: Splunk integration uses the HTTP Event Collector: set LOG_AGGREGATOR_HOST to the full HEC URL with port (default 8088), e.g. https://<splunk>:8088/services/collector/event, LOG_AGGREGATOR_TYPE splunk, the HEC token as password, and the loggers to send, via /api/v2/settings/logging.
questions: How do I send controller logs to Splunk?
Why are Splunk logs not received from controller?
What URL do I use for Splunk HEC in controller?
What port does Splunk HTTP Event Collector use?

answer_card.title: Send controller logs to Splunk
answer_card.answer_md:
PATCH `https://<controller>/api/v2/settings/logging`:
```json
{
  "LOG_AGGREGATOR_HOST": "https://<splunk>:8088/services/collector/event",
  "LOG_AGGREGATOR_PORT": null,
  "LOG_AGGREGATOR_TYPE": "splunk",
  "LOG_AGGREGATOR_PASSWORD": "<HEC token>",
  "LOG_AGGREGATOR_LOGGERS": ["awx", "activity_stream", "job_events", "system_tracking"],
  "LOG_AGGREGATOR_ENABLED": true
}
```
Include the port in the host URL, or Splunk will not process the events.
